raw.title: Account Executive Firm Expansion
raw.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)

  • Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe

Process de recrutement

- Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

- Un deuxième entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min)

- Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h)

- Un Final Round avec Jacob, Head of Sales SMEs (45 min)

- Un Team Fit Interview avec les membres de l'équipe (45 min) - sur site

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. raw.title: Chef de Projet Fonctionnel – Migration Comptable (Télétravail complet possible)
raw.description:
Et si ton expertise comptable devenait le pont entre les cabinets et la technologie qui va transformer leur métier ?

Chez Pennylane, on a une conviction forte : les experts-comptables méritent des outils à la hauteur de leur métier. Des outils qui leur font gagner du temps sur les tâches répétitives, pour qu'ils puissent se concentrer sur ce qui compte vraiment : le conseil, l'accompagnement, la relation client. C'est pour ça qu'on a construit une plateforme tout-en-un qui réunit experts-comptables et dirigeants sur le même outil.

Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, ayant déjà participé idéalement à une ou plusieurs migrations vers un nouveau logiciel comptable. Ta connaissance du métier et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de les accompagner au mieux dans la migration de leurs données comptables vers Pennylane.

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l'équipe Partner Solutions Specialists, composée intégralement d'anciens comptables. Une équipe qui comprend les enjeux des cabinets de l'intérieur, et qui les accompagne avec le bon niveau d'expertise métier, de rigueur et d'empathie.

En tant que PSS Front, tu es l'expert métier en contact direct avec toutes les parties prenantes pendant les projets de migration. Tu travailles en binôme avec le PSS Back (Partner Solutions Architect), qui prend en charge l'intégration et les aspects techniques. Toi, tu es le visage du projet côté cabinet : celui ou celle qui cadre, qui rassure, qui fait avancer.

C'est un rôle exigeant, au croisement de la gestion de projet, de l'expertise comptable et de la relation client, avec une vraie dimension de conseil et d'amélioration continue.

📋 Tes missions au quotidien

Audit et analyse des besoins fonctionnels

  • Planifier, préparer et animer les réunions avec les cabinets — du lancement au Retex, en passant par les briefings, cadrages et restitutions

  • Analyser les besoins métiers à partir des retours terrain et des expériences de migration

  • Rédiger la documentation et les user stories pour faciliter la compréhension des autres équipes

  • Animer des ateliers et webinaires — certains centrés sur les usages métiers, d'autres plus transverses

Gestion de projet de migration

  • S'assurer que les migrations suivent un cheminement clair et documenté, pour toutes les parties prenantes (internes et externes)

  • Adapter la démarche en fonction des situations, tout en veillant au respect des process existants pour garantir une vraie collaboration inter-équipes

  • Communiquer régulièrement sur l'alignement entre les solutions techniques et les besoins métiers

  • Être le relais d'information vers le PSS Back, en charge de l'intégration, de la correction et du contrôle

Préparation métier et paramétrage

  • Contribuer à la configuration de Pennylane pour l'adapter aux processus métiers existants des cabinets

  • Participer aux tests fonctionnels pour valider que la solution répond aux exigences métiers avant la migration

Support post-migration et recettes

  • Collaborer avec les équipes PSS Back sur le débogage et la résolution des problèmes métiers après migration

  • Conduire des tests fonctionnels intermédiaires et finaux pour valider les solutions

  • Contribuer aux rapports post-migration et proposer des axes d'amélioration

Automatisation et optimisation des processus

  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins en automatisation et en optimisation

  • Participer à leur mise en œuvre via de la documentation, des feedbacks ou des propositions concrètes

  • Suivre la satisfaction métier après chaque évolution

Veille, R&D et amélioration continue

  • Assurer une veille produit et métier pour garantir la pertinence des fonctionnalités

  • Proposer des améliorations sur l'existant et signaler les manques ou dysfonctionnements

  • Contribuer à la transformation des besoins en solutions actionnables, pour l'interne comme pour l'externe

Collaboration Front / Back

  • Connaître les enjeux des tâches du PSS Back et pouvoir intervenir ponctuellement sur la production selon les besoins

🙋 Le profil qu'on recherche

  • Formation comptable : IUT GEA, BTS CGO, DCG, DSCG, Master CCA — tu as les bases solides

  • Expérience en cabinet d'expertise-comptable, idéalement avec une ou plusieurs migrations déjà vécues

  • À l'aise à l'oral comme à l'écrit, tu interagis avec les comptables de manière claire, professionnelle et crédible

  • Sens du service et de la relation client : tu comprends les besoins, tu y réponds, et tu entretiens une vraie relation de confiance dans la durée

  • Capable de travailler en autonomie comme en équipe, avec une vraie flexibilité pour t'adapter aux évolutions rapides du produit

  • Envie d'apprendre en continu et de rester à jour sur les évolutions fonctionnelles de Pennylane

  • Anglais niveau A2 minimum

Les "nice to have"

  • À l'aise dans un environnement startup

  • Anglais niveau B1

  • Bon esprit de synthèse et vraie pédagogie

  • Proactivité et autonomie marquées

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un Business Recruiter — pour se découvrir et poser les bases

  2. Un entretien avec un Team Leader PSS — pour rentrer dans le fond du poste

  3. Un cas pratique avec un Partner Solutions Specialist — pour voir comment tu travailles concrètement

  4. Une dernière rencontre avec le ou la Head of Partner Success — pour valider l'alignement sur la vision et la culture

 

🎁 Ce que l'on peut t'offrir

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 8 et 13 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d'accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃 Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois pour que les Pennylaners en remote se retrouvent, et un séminaire annuel pour vivre de grands moments de cohésion

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra :

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du poste)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une vraie priorité — avec ton équipe comme avec les autres parties prenantes

  • Savoir prendre du recul pour prioriser les actions à fort impact dans son activité quotidienne

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. On sait que les profils les plus intéressants sont rarement des copies conformes d'une fiche de poste. Ce qui compte, c'est ta trajectoire, ta façon de penser, et l'envie de contribuer à quelque chose qui a du sens.

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d'arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l'adresse e-mail de l'expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com.

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d'informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s'agit d'une fraude — ne répondez pas et signalez-le nous immédiatement.

Encourageant la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l'épanouissement. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . As an interface between suppliers, IPP / EPC contractors and clients you keep up to date with and pass on market trends, technology development, new products, standards and simulation models. title: Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois
description: 🚀 Rejoignez une institution d’excellence et d’innovation en tant qu’ Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de recherche en intelligence artificielle appliquée à la vision industrielle 3D, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, innovation technologique et transfert vers l’industrie, affecté(e) au Centre Fayol de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne. Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol. Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. ✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. Au sein de ce centre de recherche pluridisciplinaire (plus de 80 personnes), reconnu pour son expertise en IA, systèmes cyber-physiques et sciences des données, vous contribuerez à des projets de R&D à fort impact pour l’industrie du futur. Le centre s’appuie notamment sur sa plateformes technologiques IT'M Factory et est un acteur-clé de l'enseignement et de l'innovation au sein de l’Institut Mines-Télécom. Dans le cadre du projet régional DIGIMAN3D, financé par la Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, ce recrutement vise à développer et expérimenter une solution de contrôle dimensionnel 3D en ligne, basée sur l’acquisition de données 3D et l’intelligence artificielle, pour le contrôle automatisé de pièces mécaniques de précision en conditions industrielles. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : · Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure. · Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles. · Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm. · Vous participez à l’intégration et à l’évaluation des modèles développés sur banc d’essai, puis sur machine à commande numérique et en conditions réelles de production, en collaboration avec les partenaires du consortium. · Vous rendez compte de vos travaux par des rapports techniques, des résultats expérimentaux, des démonstrateurs fonctionnels et des interactions régulières avec les partenaires scientifiques et industriels du projet. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet, à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire dialoguer recherche, développement et application industrielle sera essentielle pour réussir. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un : · Diplôme Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur ou master 2) en science de données, informatique, intelligence artificielle, traitement d’image. Et idéalement : · Avec une expérience de 1 à 3 ans dans le secteur de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée, notamment à des projets en vision par ordinateur, segmentation, ou détection d’anomalies. Et vous possédez : • Une expérience significative en développement d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle ou de vision par ordinateur. • Une expérience confirmée en programmation Python avec des bibliothèques IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV) • Une expertise avérée en apprentissage non supervisé ou auto-supervisé, détection d’anomalies • Une maîtrise de l’anglais technique (niveau B2 confirmé) Vos atouts supplémentaires : · Connaissances en intégration sur matériel industriel (edge computing, GPU, PC embarqué) · Intérêt pour la transfert technologique et l'impact industriel concret 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 1er novembre 2026 ℹ️ Informations complémentaires Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 24 mois Localisation du poste : Saint-Étienne (42). Rémunération fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom. Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique (catégorie A - détaché sur contrat) et/ou aux personnes contractuelles. À moyen terme, un poste pérenne est susceptible d’être ouvert. Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative Les candidats présélectionnés après examen de leur dossier seront convoqués à un entretien à Saint-Étienne ou à distance en visioconférence (le lien de connexion sera communiqué ultérieurement). 📞 Contacts o Sur le contenu du poste : Anis HOAYEK – Maitre de Conférence HDR Mail : o Sur les aspects administratifs/RH : Amélie HUCHET – Gestionnaire RH Mail : Tél. : +33 (0)4 77 42 93 05 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an Un soutien à l’intégration : indépendamment de la participation à nos projets de recherche, l’Institut Henri Fayol vous assure les moyens financiers pour présenter vos travaux à 1 conférence internationale et un stagiaire en soutien. Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science , l’ ingénierie , et des projets qui font sens . · Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure.

· Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles.

· Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm.

· Vous participez à l’intégration et à l’évaluation des modèles développés sur banc d’essai, puis sur machine à commande numérique et en conditions réelles de production, en collaboration avec les partenaires du consortium.

· Vous rendez compte de vos travaux par des rapports techniques, des résultats expérimentaux, des démonstrateurs fonctionnels et des interactions régulières avec les partenaires scientifiques et industriels du projet.

 

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet, à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire dialoguer recherche, développement et application industrielle sera essentielle pour réussir.

raw.title: Endear - Product Designer
raw.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

raw.description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

raw.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge - close to your users. They power use cases such as webhook receivers, AI inferences, OG image generation and real-time bots (Slack, Discord, etc). Built on top of Supabase Edge Runtime: an open-source, Deno-based runtime written in Rust that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

We want developers to be able to build truly global applications by distributing both compute and data globally. Infrastructure concerns like regions, cold starts, CPU and memory provisioning should fade into the background so developers can focus on iterating on business logic.

We are looking for experienced and passionate engineers to help us go further in this vision.

What You’ll Own

  • Evolving Supabase Edge Runtime - an Open-sourced Rust-based host that runs the Deno isolate, manages the main/user runtime split, and enforces per-request memory and CPU limits.

  • Implementing monitoring, alerting, and OpenTelemetry tracing across the runtime, then using that visibility to drive optimizations that improve latency and reliability of the service.

  • Working closely with the Deno and other open-source teams, contributing to upstream and relaying our users' requirements.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation to keep Edge Functions healthy in production.

  • Help manage and improve features like scheduled functions, background tasks, WebSockets streaming, ephemeral file storage, and custom routing.

  • Integrating functions more tightly with the rest of the Supabase stack - Auth, Postgres, Storage, and Realtime.

  • Expanding functions to support more use cases (AI inference, MCP servers, hosting simple websites, URL shorteners).

  • Improving the DX of developing and debugging functions locally through the Supabase CLI, including DevTools integration, logging, and production parity.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with strong fluency in Rust and TypeScript.

  • Experience with V8 Isolates, Deno and the JavaScript runtimes in general.

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale - Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Redis, or comparable systems.

  • A strong vision for how compute and data can be pushed to the edge.

  • Bonus: experience building developer-facing CLIs or front-end tooling that sits on top of an infrastructure product.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Software Engineer - Auth
description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the role Auth , written in Go (server) and with client libraries for TypeScript , SSR and for other frameworks and technologies, is one of the most popular products in the Supabase stack. We are seeking someone to help us build new and maintain existing Auth features. What you’ll be responsible for Designing and implementing secure, scalable authentication features in Go and TypeScript. Working across the stack: from server-side protocols to client-side libraries for frameworks like Next.js. Owning the performance, reliability, and scalability of the Auth server across Supabase's infrastructure. Contributing to the evolution of our Auth architecture, including support for OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and other protocols. Planning and executing safe database migrations across a large fleet of Postgres instances. Building and improving observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards to keep the system healthy at scale. Writing and reviewing RFCs as part of our product development process. Collaborating with engineers across Supabase to ensure a seamless experience for developers using our tools. Supporting the community and responding to developer feedback on GitHub, Discord, and other channels. You might be a good fit if you (Required) Have 4+ years of professional experience writing and shipping Go in production. (Required) Have 2+ years of professional experience working on an authentication system (implementing protocol support, maintenance at scale). (Required) Have strong relational database experience (Postgres or MySQL); Postgres experience is a bonus. Have strong knowledge of TypeScript in addition to Go (languages used daily). Have strong knowledge of web technology fundamentals (cookies, sessions, JWT, HTTP, browser APIs). Have good knowledge of and deep interest in authentication security (passwords, protocols such as OAuth, OIDC or SAML, cryptography fundamentals such as hash functions, signatures and ciphers). Have experience working with multiple web frameworks like Next.js (or other SSR alternative in the JavaScript space) and traditional web frameworks like Ruby on Rails, Django, Laravel or equivalent (in any language). Have good technical writing skills (RFC process is an important part of making changes to the Auth product). Have hands-on experience building and operating services at significant scale. Have deep understanding of systems-level concerns: memory management, concurrency patterns, and compute resource optimization in Go. Have experience with Kubernetes and AWS (or comparable cloud platform) in a production setting. About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the role

Auth, written in Go (server) and with client libraries for TypeScript, SSR and for other frameworks and technologies, is one of the most popular products in the Supabase stack. We are seeking someone to help us build new and maintain existing Auth features.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Designing and implementing secure, scalable authentication features in Go and TypeScript.

  • Working across the stack: from server-side protocols to client-side libraries for frameworks like Next.js.

  • Owning the performance, reliability, and scalability of the Auth server across Supabase's infrastructure.

  • Contributing to the evolution of our Auth architecture, including support for OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and other protocols.

  • Planning and executing safe database migrations across a large fleet of Postgres instances.

  • Building and improving observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards to keep the system healthy at scale.

  • Writing and reviewing RFCs as part of our product development process.

  • Collaborating with engineers across Supabase to ensure a seamless experience for developers using our tools.

  • Supporting the community and responding to developer feedback on GitHub, Discord, and other channels.

You might be a good fit if you

  • (Required) Have 4+ years of professional experience writing and shipping Go in production.

  • (Required) Have 2+ years of professional experience working on an authentication system (implementing protocol support, maintenance at scale).

  • (Required) Have strong relational database experience (Postgres or MySQL); Postgres experience is a bonus.

  • Have strong knowledge of TypeScript in addition to Go (languages used daily).

  • Have strong knowledge of web technology fundamentals (cookies, sessions, JWT, HTTP, browser APIs).

  • Have good knowledge of and deep interest in authentication security (passwords, protocols such as OAuth, OIDC or SAML, cryptography fundamentals such as hash functions, signatures and ciphers).

  • Have experience working with multiple web frameworks like Next.js (or other SSR alternative in the JavaScript space) and traditional web frameworks like Ruby on Rails, Django, Laravel or equivalent (in any language).

  • Have good technical writing skills (RFC process is an important part of making changes to the Auth product).

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating services at significant scale.

  • Have deep understanding of systems-level concerns: memory management, concurrency patterns, and compute resource optimization in Go.

  • Have experience with Kubernetes and AWS (or comparable cloud platform) in a production setting.

  • Have solid grasp of observability practices — metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

  • Have experience managing database schema migrations safely at scale.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Company Description

ecosio is a fast-growing, innovative service company and a leading provider of B2B integration, specialising in electronic data interchange (EDI), Web EDI and e-invoicing. ecosio is part of Vertex, Inc., a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions listed on Nasdaq (VERX).

Our brand slogan is Connections That Work as we believe strong connections are central to successful business relationships - both external and internal. At ecosio, we hire individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We are technology lovers, set the highest standards for our solutions, and put innovative ideas first.

Job Description

You'll connect with the role if you enjoy...

  • optimising e-invoicing and global supply chains by planning, coordinating and technically implementing e-invoicing and EDI projects on our cloud platform
  • communicating worldwide with our partner companies, customers and their suppliers
  • acting as the interface between our customers, their ERP System and our SaaS platform
  • taking on new customers (after handover from Sales) and independently progressing your integration projects
  • appearing as a sparring partner for our customers and solving their technical issues
  • performing proactively to ensure each project’s success
  • coordinating mappings for e-invoicing and EDI integration with the document engineering team for your integration projects
  • encouraging the evaluation and implementation of new tools and processes for the project and managing the process

Qualifications

To connect with ecosio it is important to have…

  • several years of work experience in e-invoicing and/or EDI
  • experience with the integration of ERP import and export interfaces based on XML, CSV and IDocs
  • experience with EDI onboardings, EDI service providers and Value Added Networks (VANs)
  • experience with national e-invoicing mandates around the globe
  • in-depth knowledge of typical EDI and integration formats like XML, EDIFACT, ANSI X12, and VDA as well as EDI protocols like AS2, OFTP2 or PEPPOL
  • excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage (French, German, Italian, Chinese, etc)
  • know-how in project management, supply chain management and/or logistics
  • strong organisational skills and enjoy working independently

Additional Information

By connecting with us you will experience...

  • Our remote-first culture lets you work remotely from one of our designated countries
  • Flexible working hours to suit your schedule and priorities
  • Annual personal development budget to invest in conferences, courses, or career coaching
  • Home office allowance to create a workspace that fits your needs
  • Regular events and trips to connect, celebrate, and have fun with the team
  • Workations of up to 90 days per year within the EU, combining travel and productivity
  • Wellbeing support, including mental health resources and employee assistance programs
  • Additional country-specific benefits based on your location


Sounds like a connection that works? Then apply now and we will get in touch soon!

As part of our hiring process at ecosio, we conduct standard background checks. You can find more information about them by clicking HERE.

Our mission is to build Connections That Work by fostering a diverse and inclusive team. We are committed to making everyone feel valued and empowered to contribute their unique skills, experiences and perspectives. And now we want to connect with you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. AI is fundamental to how we work AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at. What we're looking for: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating. You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform. In this role, you will: Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC. Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on. Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal. Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation. Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations. Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build. Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack. Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions. Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it. This role will be right for you, if: You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes. Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems. AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast. Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance. Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights. Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together. Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams. A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates. Nice to have: Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling. Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems. Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms. On-call or incident response experience. What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition. Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey. Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that. Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly. Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand. Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places. Flexible, human-first culture. Stipend for setting up your home office. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A few things to note: Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. raw.title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
raw.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.
    This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits.

  2. AI is the buyer.
    Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on.

  3. Financial Services & Regulated business.
    Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated.

We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical.

  • WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market.

  • Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially.

It is a rare role to build category-defining companies learn how they get built, from the inside, at the frontier of AI. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned.

The mission

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two:

80% - real company-building

Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live.

  • Go-to-market, your main focus: you own GTM for each company: positioning, first customers, sales, pricing, go-to-market experiments, and the tools, automations and trackers needed to run them. Hexa’s central pool covers product and design; GTM sits with you. You are part of the company and our growth depend on you.

  • In the operational rhythm of each company: weekly kick-offs, product meetings, end-of-week recaps. You own the cadence, objectives set, notes written, decisions tracked, and leverage AI so we focus our time on building and selling not writing down plans.

  • The founders’ first port of call on anything outside their own scope, and the interface between the ventures and the rest of Hexa (Finance, Legal, Talent, Comms), pulling in the right resource when a project needs it.

20% - studio operations

  • How we run as a studio: keeping the machine sharp and the founder pipeline full.

  • Discovery transforming new ideas into tangible opportunities: discovery outreach and meeting, market sizing, value chain, positioning, the opportunity note that gets a project greenlit.

  • Growing the founder pipeline: working with the Talent team on the sourcing strategy for each new project, gathering top talent in the industry and making WTF visible to the best potential founders and ecosystem players.

  • Building visibility: working with the brand team on Raphaël’s and the studio’s reputation.

  • Improving how the studio (and Hexa) runs: sharpening shared AI agent and tooling (GTM ex: github repo), playbooks and best practice (ex: grokbot rollout), and reusable systems that make the studio & Hexa as a whole compound over time.

Who we’re looking for.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience as founder, go-to-market, growth, operations or even engineering in tech company/ecossystem. This is your shot to build real things, not assist. How you execute and you track executing matters more than the title on your resume.

  • A builder. You’ve been hands-on inside an early-stage startup, or founded something yourself, and you build things: automations, tools, dashboards, experiments.

  • A genuine go-to-market appetite: you’re not afraid to reach out cold, and you like the hands-on part of landing the first customers. You will meet real people and sell while being nobody for them.

  • High agency. You’re the person who figures it out and ships, without waiting to be told how.

  • Hard worker and hungry: you want to be part of building great companies, and you bring energy, hard work and rigor to it.

  • AI nerd: you use AI tools on a daily basis and constantly test switch to better setup.

  • Comfortable being in front of people: reaching out to founders, hosting events, representing the studio.

  • Working in English


Recruitment process

  • First call with Louise (current GTM lead): introduction to Hexa, WTF, check on cultural fit.

  • Interview with Raphaël: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: an exercise inspired by our real work.

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO) and Camille (VP Talent)


What we offer

  • Direct equity in the studio's companies

  • Opportunity to invest in Hexa portfolio startups at a preferential rate

  • Swile meal card

  • Mobility budget: €500/year for green transportation (bike, metro, electric scooter)
